name: OMG: Our Manic Game
summary: In Our Manic Game, it’s all about bullets. And risk. And reward. But mainly bullets. The twist in this shoot ’em up is that bullets can either kill you, or make you smile. The very moment a foe explodes, all his bullets vanish in the air, and are turned into points. To maximize your score, all enemies can be enraged by touching them on the screen. When berserk, they shoot way more bullets, and change their behaviour. It may be risky, but it can be worth it.
